tasks.title: Review follow-up for EXT-03-3 (self-review of 4518b26): verify each of the 12 findings in code, fix the confirmed ones with revert cycles
implementation: Findings come from the read-only adversarial review of commit 4518b26; the numbered list below is their content (each is to be verified in code before it is fixed).
1 observer hooks lose RAPIDLM_SESSION_ID/RAPIDLM_TURN_ID (thread-local identity not carried to the worker): carry RunIdentity in the job and scope it around the run.
2 hook.dropped undercounts a burst (only the first drop of an interval is recorded; counts are lost when no sink, or at exit): keep per-session buckets, flush on an idle timeout and at drain.

3 one FIFO: drop-attribution to the wrong ledger, notification hooks delaying permission_requested, drop-oldest evicting a permission event: bucket drops by session, prefer dropping notification-class events, run permission stages first.

4 duplicate notifications (agent_finished+job_finished, monitor_flooded+job_finished, turn_complete+loop_result) and false 'a hundred lines fires nothing' claim; 'continued' outcome always: correct the docs and the outcomes.

5 'redacted' not true; title bound 512 vs spec 200; observe_approval_request does not apply redact_output: redact summary/title, bound title to 200, warn in hooks.md that the fields carry model/server text.
6 goal_changed: budget-exhausted block never notifies; pause during an autonomous run fires twice; misplaced doc comment on notify_goal_changed.
7 per-event settings reload (false 'nothing is read' comment), full-session export to find a resolved request's tool, managed gate report dropped, mixed snapshot vs reload.
8 vacuous tests (hang test, exit-drain, wiring of attach_ledger_sinks / record_clarification / fire_turn_end_hooks / remember flag); env-dependent tests should use load_project_integrations_with.
9 worker robustness: catch_unwind, spawn failure resets started, drain result at exit reported, error print not delayed by the drain.
10 unrecorded runs: observer failures neither recorded nor warned when there is no ledger.
11 managed observer hooks do not run for untrusted projects: correct the claim.
12 outcome vocabulary, remember semantics, agent_finished queued before terminal.
validation: each confirmed finding has a test that fails with the fix reverted; refuted findings are recorded with the reading that refutes them
evidence: docs/goals/ext-surface/ext-delivery.md#ext-03-3-r

tasks.title: Review follow-up for EXT-04-0 (self-review of 081396a): verify each finding in code, fix the confirmed ones with revert cycles
implementation: 1 (high) a /skill message over 16 KiB makes the terminal UI's session view refuse the turn.started text (display bound 16 KiB) and block every later event: the block must fit the display bound (cut the body so header+body+footer stay under it) and the reducer must not be frozen by a long typed prompt.
2 (medium) the /skill message is scanned for @path file references: the skill author's text must not trigger attachments (skip reference scanning for a skill message).
3 (medium) subagents are given the listing block though not the tool: build_live_context must not list skills for a child, nor when workspace tools are unavailable; one discovery per turn.

4 (medium) a typed activation is claimed and recorded before the message is known to be delivered (actions blocked, queued behind a running turn, hook-blocked): record and claim only once the turn is started; a queued one must not tell the running turn 'already active'.
5 (medium-low) /skill typed right after a compaction is cleared by the next turn's observe_compaction: observe before claiming, or key the claim to the generation.
6 (medium-low) workflow agent steps get the listing and tool but no skill.activated sink; exec --skill replays its event after turn.started: attach the sink in workflow steps; record the event first.

7 (low-medium) body_digest covers the arguments; arguments are cut with the body at 16 KiB and still recorded as delivered; a repeat model call with new arguments is silently 'already active': digest the skill text alone, keep the arguments inside the bound, say when arguments are ignored.
8 (low) Tab completion cannot complete ids with uppercase letters and prints candidates with a leading slash.

9 (low) a user's custom command named 'skill' is now shadowed (record and report); the doctor reference doc omits the skills row; parse_exec_args consumes --skill tokens of an unquoted prompt (record).
10 (low) rapid skills show builds the directory from the id, not the file; prints the body raw (control characters).
11 tests: claim-before-read under concurrency; tests that read the developer's real home; the plan-mode negative test is a regression guard only (record).
validation: each confirmed finding has a test that fails with the fix reverted; refuted findings are recorded with the reading that refutes them
evidence: docs/goals/ext-surface/ext-delivery.md#ext-04-0-r

phase_notes.note: EXT-02-0 landed: streamable-HTTP MCP calls work end to end (JSON and event-stream replies, 202 acknowledgements, 401/403 mapped with a bounded parsed challenge), static credentials by environment variable or literal header, egress gate and receipts, rapid mcp add --url, install writes type, stdio-only statements corrected.

EXT-03-1 and EXT-03-2 landed together: hook entries may be objects with an anchored matcher and a per-hook timeout, rejected (not skipped) when malformed, merged and deduplicated across both settings files and the managed policy, clamped by a managed max_timeout_ms; a timed-out hook's whole process group is ended.

EXT-03-3 landed: permission_requested, permission_resolved and notification observer stages, fired from every request, resolution and attention site, delivered off the emitting path through one bounded queue (hook.dropped when it overflows).
